html:
SMTO-UI-0025 — This model setting's number is too high or too low

GUID: 4a391101-7d57-4d59-a76e-ec2d5c5934f7
Slug: ui-number-out-of-range
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • The number you entered for this model setting is outside the range it allows. SMTO didn't accept the change.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In Settings › Setup › Model routing, open the model and find the setting that has the message under it. The message appears right under the setting whose number is outside its limits.
  2. Use the up and down arrows in that box to find its limits; they stop at the lowest and highest allowed values. If zero is refused, choose a number just above it. Each model setting has its own limits, and some must be greater than a number rather than equal to it.
  3. If you're unsure, open its Help and use the Explicit starting value, or turn the switch off. Then select Save for that model. The starting value is inside the range, and turning the switch off uses the provider's default.

What success looks like

  • The message under the setting disappears and the model saves.

If it still fails

  • Turn the setting's switch off to use the provider default, and send the copied error details to the person who manages SMTO's model setup.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A numeric model parameter value is below the schema minimum, above the schema maximum, or not greater than the schema exclusiveMinimum.

What this means

  • Numeric input falls outside schema minimum/maximum or is not above an exclusive minimum. The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Numeric input falls outside schema minimum/maximum or is not above an exclusive minimum.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the marked bound and whether it is inclusive or exclusive.

How to fix it

  • In model_configuration.js the input change handler throws ui_number_out_of_range when the value violates schema.minimum/maximum or is <= schema.exclusiveMinimum (the input's min/max attributes mirror minimum/maximum). Choose a value inside the parameter's schema bounds (parameter definitions in src/agent_runtime/llm/model_configuration.py), or turn the override off.
  • Use the minimum and maximum shown for this field, including any exclusive lower bound.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended value satisfies every advertised numeric bound.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
